What's new in DuckOS 1.0.66

• Settings › Passwords, laid out anew: six cards — All, Passkeys, Codes, Wi-Fi, Security, Deleted — with a search and a “+”.
• One-time codes (the six digits an authenticator app gives): scan a site's QR code with DuckOS Camera or type the key; the codes tick here and go to DuckCloud with your passwords.
• Security: reused and easy-to-guess passwords, and a leak check (haveibeenpwned, only five characters of each hash leave the phone).
• Deleted: a removed password stays 30 days, to be had back. Wi-Fi: the phone's networks and the ones you keep in DuckCloud.
